description: Evidence bundle for an entity: for each requested property (default: its core facts) every statement with rank, qualifiers and all its references (stated in, reference URL, title, publication and retrieval dates, archive URL), a reference-quality grade (sourced, wiki_imported, unsourced), and the Wikipedia articles linked to the entity. Reference URLs are as recorded by the source; they are not fetched live. Price: 0.02 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"reality_get_evidence"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/reality/evidence?id=Q7624104&properties=P571%2CP159%2CP1128%2CP2139

properties.description: property ids, comma separated, up to 10 (default: core facts)
